message.content:
### Overall Layout & Structure  
The page has a **full-width, dark-themed (black background)** layout with a clean, structured design centered around a pricing table for a catering service ("Стоимость банкета" = "Banquet Cost"). The header, main content, and footer (minimal) are vertically stacked, with the main content (pricing plans) occupying the majority of the viewport.  


### Header Section  
- **Logo & Branding**: Top-left features a logo with the text "UNILOV" (stylized, likely a serif font) and "CATERIN" (smaller, uppercase) in a light gold color.  
- **Navigation Menu**: Centered top, with three menu items in uppercase, light gold text: "ФОРМАТЫ" (Formats), "МЕНЮ" (Menu), "КОНТАКТЫ" (Contacts).  
- **Contact Info**: Top-right displays a phone number: "+7 (812) 919-59-11" in the same light gold color.  
- **Visual Hierarchy**: The header uses a thin, light gold border to separate it from the main content, creating a clear top boundary.  


### Main Content (Pricing Section)  
- **Title & Subtitle**:  
  - Main title: "Стоимость банкета" (Banquet Cost) in a large, elegant serif font (likely a script or decorative serif) in white, centered.  
  - Subtitle: "Три уровня обслуживания под любой бюджет и масштаб мероприятия" (Three service levels for any budget and event scale) in smaller, white sans-serif text, centered below the title.  

- **Pricing Plans**: Three rectangular cards (dark gray/black with subtle borders) arranged horizontally, evenly spaced. Each card has:  
  - **Plan Name**: Uppercase, white text (e.g., "Классик" = Classic, "Премиум" = Premium, "Гранд" = Grand).  
  - **Price**: "ОТ [price] /чел" (From [price] /person) in large, light gold text (e.g., "ОТ 4 000 /чел").  
  - **Features**: A bulleted list (checkmarks in light gold) of included services, in small white sans-serif text (e.g., "Трёхкусовый ужин" = Three-course dinner, "Стандартное обслуживание" = Standard service).  
  - **Call-to-Action (CTA) Button**: "ЗАКАЗАТЬ" (Order) in uppercase, light gold text on a dark gold button, centered below the features.  

- **Highlighting**: The "Премиум" (Premium) card has a light gold border and a "ПОПУЛЯРНЫЙ" (Popular) badge in a rounded, light gold pill at the top, distinguishing it as the recommended plan.  


### Footer & Additional Elements  
- **Bottom Left**: A small, circular logo (likely a monogram) with "N" in white on a black background.  
- **Bottom Right**: A green circular icon (WhatsApp logo) for contact, with a white chat bubble.  


### Colors  
- **Background**: Solid black (#000000).  
- **Text**: White (primary) and light gold (#D4AF37, a warm, metallic gold) for accents (prices, CTAs, checkmarks, badges).  
- **Cards**: Dark gray/black (#1A1A1A) with subtle borders (light gold for the highlighted "Премиум" card).  


### Typography  
- **Titles**: Large, elegant serif font (e.g., Playfair Display) for "Стоимость банкета" (high contrast against black).  
- **Body Text**: Clean sans-serif (e.g., Arial, Helvetica) for subtitles, menu items, and feature lists (readable and modern).  
- **CTA Buttons**: Uppercase sans-serif (matching body text) for "ЗАКАЗАТЬ" (consistent with the overall minimalist style).  


### Spacing & Alignment  
- **Header**: Logo, menu, and contact info are horizontally aligned with even spacing.  
- **Main Content**: Title/subtitle are centered; pricing cards are evenly spaced (consistent margin between them).  
- **Cards**: Internal spacing (padding) is generous, with features listed vertically (consistent line height) and CTAs centered.  
- **Consistency**: Uniform padding/margins across cards ensure visual balance.  


### Images & Visuals  
- **Logo**: Minimalist, text-based (no complex imagery).  
- **WhatsApp Icon**: Simple, recognizable green circle with white chat bubble (functional, not decorative).  
- **No Other Images**: The design relies on typography and color to convey information (no photos or illustrations).  


### Visual Issues (None Detected)  
- **Contrast**: Text (white/light gold) contrasts well with the black background (meets accessibility standards).  
- **Alignment**: All elements are neatly aligned (no overlapping or mispositioned items).  
- **Consistency**: Color, typography, and spacing are uniform across the page (no jarring inconsistencies).  


### Summary  
The page is a sleek, minimalist pricing page for a catering service, using a dark theme with gold/white accents to highlight key information (prices, CTAs, recommended plan). The layout is intuitive, with clear hierarchy and consistent spacing, ensuring easy navigation and readability. No visual issues impact usability or aesthetics.
